entities.name: Folquet de Marseille
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Folquet de Marselha came from a Genoese merchant family who lived in Marseille. He was a celebrated troubadour who, after a religious conversion, became a Cistercian monk and later the bishop of Toulouse.
